Slow dolly-in. Faint Korean street cry, wind howl, distant church bells, crunching snow under boots.

Photorealistic dream vision, a towering Christmas tree covered in lit candles and painted ornaments. a barefoot girl of about nine with reddish-gold hair under a patched gray coat, clutching a bundle of matchboxes reaches up in wonder. Slow tilt up. Soft Korean choir, candle sizzle, ornament glass chimes.
